info.title: Primemover API
info.description: Web automation platform API for managing browser automation experiments

post.description:
Exchange credentials for OAuth token

**Curl Example:**
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://pm-api.test.primemover.example/api/v1/auth/token' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "grant_type": "client_credentials",
    "client_id": "your_client_id",
    "client_secret": "your_client_secret"
  }'
```

**R Example:**
```r
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

response <- POST(
  url = "https://pm-api.test.primemover.example/api/v1/auth/token",
  add_headers(
    "Content-Type" = "application/json",
    "Accept" = "application/json"
  ),
  body = toJSON(list(
    grant_type = "client_credentials",
    client_id = "your_client_id",
    client_secret = "your_client_secret"
  ), auto_unbox = TRUE)
)

token_data <- content(response, "parsed")
print(token_data)
```

post.description:
Create a new browser agent configuration

**Curl Example:**
```bash

  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN' \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "name": "Chrome Agent",
    "description": "Chrome browser agent",
    "identification": "chrome",

    "active": true
```

**R Example:**

```r
response <- POST(
```

post.description:
Upload configuration data or file to a crawler

**Curl Example (with file):**
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://pm-api.test.primemover.example/api/v1/crawlers/1/upload' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -F 'file=@crawler_config.json'
```

**Curl Example (with JSON content):**
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://pm-api.test.primemover.example/api/v1/crawlers/1/upload' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "content": "{\\"name\\":\\"Test Crawler\\",\\"active\\"1}"
  }'
```

**R Example (with file):**
```r
library(httr)

response <- POST(
  url = "https://pm-api.test.primemover.example/api/v1/crawlers/1/upload",
  add_headers(
    "Authorization" = "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN",
    "Accept" = "application/json"
  ),
  body = list(file = upload_file("crawler_config.json")),
  encode = "multipart"
)

upload_result <- content(response, "parsed")
print(upload_result)
```

items.example: The file field is required when content is not present.

get.description:
Download experiment data as a file (ZIP archive)

**Curl Example:**
```bash
curl -X GET 'https://pm-api.test.primemover.example/api/v1/experiments/1/download' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Accept: application/zip' \
  -o experiment_1_data.zip
```

**R Example:**
```r
library(httr)

response <- GET(
  url = "https://pm-api.test.primemover.example/api/v1/experiments/1/download",
  add_headers(
    "Authorization" = "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN",
    "Accept" = "application/zip"
  )
)

# Save the file
writeBin(content(response, "raw"), "experiment_1_data.zip")
print("File downloaded successfully")
```
